G. 3000 11.37
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No. ......
S.1. Special Branch /////,
REPORT    Date December 28, .o 37
Subject. Local Chinese residents pledge allegiance to National Government.
Made by...D. S. McEown    Forwarded by C. Carlson.

With reference to the attached newspaper cutting from
the Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury of December 11, dealing
with the above subject, the information contained therein
was the result of a radio talk from Changsha.
A copy of the manifesto as published in the Ta Mei
Wai Pao on December 11, (translation attached) was found
posted on a wall on Rue Lamaire near Avenue Edward VII.
It is significant that the Ta Mei Wan Pao is operating
a short wave five tube radio receiving set and there is a
possibility that the message was received by this means
from propagandists formerly in Shanghai who have removed
to Changsha.
A copy of the letter addressed to the French Police
regarding the operation of the set is attached.
The copy of the manifesto has been examined and
compared with others on file by the French Police but the
source cannot be traced.

（印：...）
（批：J.M. Higson. D. S.）

D.C. (Special Branch).

（批：S.1. ... C.D.J. Sih C 29/12 88241/v 1ma 29/12）

G. 3000 11.37
上海公共租界工部局警务处。    档案号 ......
S.1. 特别处 /////,
报告    日期 1937年12月28日
事由：当地中国居民宣誓效忠国民政府。
制作人...D. S. McEown    转呈人 C. Carlson。

关于随附的12月11日《上海晚邮报与信使报》（Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury）剪报，其内容涉及上述事由，其中所载信息源自长沙的一次广播谈话。
12月11日《大美晚报》（Ta Mei Wai Pao）刊登的宣言副本（附译文）被发现张贴在爱德华七世大道附近的拉迈尔路（Rue Lamaire）墙上。
值得注意的是，《大美晚报》拥有一台五管短波收音机并正在使用，因此存在这种可能性：该信息是由此前在上海、后撤至长沙的宣传人员通过此方式接收的。
随函附上致法国警察当局关于该收音机使用情况的信件副本。
该宣言副本已由法国警察部门审查，并与档案中的其他副本进行了比对，但无法追溯其来源。

（印：...）
（批：J.M. Higson. D. S.）

D.C. (特别处)。

（批：S.1. ... C.D.J. Sih C 29/12 88241/v 1ma 29/12）

page_data.en:
CIRCULAR TELEGRAM

To Chinese people throughout the country through the
Central News Agency and the newspaper offices.

Dear Brothers,
    Shanghai has been practically isolated from inland
places since the city fell into the hands of the Japanese
a month ago. There is no doubt that you have been
misinformed regarding our present conditions and cir-
cumstances.
    We wish to inform you that we will live and die
for the Republic of China. In the meantime, while the
Chinese troops are temporarily absent from this locality,
we swear to do what we can to increase the honour of
the nation, maintain our honourable attitude and continue
to support our government and leader. We will not bow
down before our enemy nor render them service. We will
not buy enemy goods, supply them with foodstuffs,
participate in any movement contrary to our conscience
or recognize any puppet organization. We are ready to
suffer and sacrifice for the country.
    The Government is requested to cooperate with the
people in rehabilitating the war sufferers, strengthen
their spirit and suppress the thought for a compromise
and exert every effort for the realization of the
national policy so that the lost territory can be
restored and the nation revived. The 3,000,000 people
in this isolated city, Shanghai, hereby pledge their full
support to the Government.

                        The 3,000,000 people in the
                        Shanghai Municipality.
page_data.zh:
通电

经由中央通讯社及各报社发往全国同胞。

各位兄弟：
    自一个月前本市落入日军手中以来，上海实际上已与内地隔绝。毫无疑问，你们关于我们目前的状况和处境受到了错误信息的误导。
    我们要告知你们，我们将为中华民国而生，为中华民国而死。与此同时，虽然中国军队暂时撤离本地区，但我们发誓尽己所能以增国家之荣誉，保持我们光荣的姿态，并继续支持我们的政府和领袖。我们绝不向敌人低头，也不为敌人服务。我们不购买敌货，不向敌人提供食品，不参与任何违背良心的运动，也不承认任何傀儡组织。我们准备为国家受苦和牺牲。
    恳请政府与民众合作，救济战争受难者，振奋其精神，压制妥协思想，并为实现国策竭尽全力，以便收复失地，复兴民族。这座孤立城市——上海的三百万人民，在此宣誓全力支持政府。

                        上海市三百万人民

page_data.en:
A manifesto issued by the 3,000,000 Chinese in Shanghai.

Dear Brethren,

It has been a month since Shanghai fell into the
hands of the enemy. In this isolated city, the 3,000,000
Chinese endure starvation and cold but they raised no
complaint. To maintain a prolonged war, the Chinese
troops had temporarily withdrawn from here but Shanghai
still belongs and will ever belong to China. The
3,000,000 Chinese in Shanghai have determinedly decided
not to be slaves nor traitors. We are citizens of the
Republic of China and will, therefore, live and die
for the Republic of China.

We experienced numerous hardships after the fall
of Shanghai into the hands of the enemy but we have
been able to maintain our justifiable attitude. We
will not do anything that will humiliate our ancestors
or spoil the glorious 5,000 year history of our nation.

We hereby swear that we will not sell our personal
character, humiliate our country, purchase enemy goods,
cooperate with the enemy, undertake any activities against
our conscience and recognize any puppet organization.

At the same time we also swear to continue to
support the National Government and General Chiang Kai
Shek, our supreme leader, to resist our enemy to the
bitter end. We oppose a compromise with the enemy
because General Chiang had announced that a midway
compromise will ruin the country.

We are fully convinced that China cannot be
conquered and Shanghai will ever belong to China, and
that to sacrifice is glorious.

Brethren! Rise Up! Struggle For The Restoration
Of The Revival Of The Nation, and For The Existence Of
The 450,000,000 Chinese Nationals.
page_data.zh:
上海三百万中国人发布的宣言。

各位同胞：

上海落入敌手已有一个月。在这座孤立的城市里，三百万中国人忍受着饥饿和寒冷，但他们毫无怨言。为了进行持久战，中国军队暂时从这里撤离，但上海仍然属于中国，并将永远属于中国。上海的三百万中国人已坚决决定不做奴隶，也不做汉奸。我们是中华民国的公民，因此将为中华民国而生，为中华民国而死。

在上海落入敌手后，我们经历了无数艰难困苦，但我们一直保持着正当的态度。我们不会做任何辱没祖先或玷污我国五千年光荣历史的事情。

我们在此宣誓，不出卖人格，不辱国格，不购买敌货，不与敌人合作，不进行任何违背良心的活动，不承认任何傀儡组织。

同时，我们也宣誓继续支持国民政府和我们的最高领袖蒋介石将军，抵抗敌人到底。我们反对与敌人妥协，因为蒋将军曾宣布，中途妥协将毁掉国家。

我们深信，中国是不可征服的，上海将永远属于中国，牺牲是光荣的。

同胞们！奋起！为民族的复兴和四亿五千万中国人的生存而奋斗！

our brethren throughout the country.
LONG LIVE THE REPUBLIC OF CHINA !

The whole body of the Chinese people

中华民国万岁！

上海全体中国人民

TA MEI WAN PAO
-:-:-:-:-:-:-:-:-

Shanghai, Dec. 16, 1937

To The Director of Police,
French Concession.

Sir,

Please be advised that the Ta Mei Wan Pao owns
and is operating a short-wave five-tube radio receiver
manufactured by the China Electric Co. At the time this
was acquired the position had been established as be-
tween the foreign and Chinese authorities that the
Chinese had jurisdiction of wireless, and Ta Mei Wan
Pao was assured by the Chinese that its actions in this
respect were correct and in order. We wish at this time,
however, in view of the changed situation, to make record
of the existing circumstances while at the same time
assuring you of our readiness to abide by any special
French Concession regulations which may exist or be framed
in future.

Very truly yours
Signed : Randal Gould
Editor.

《大美晚报》
-:-:-:-:-:-:-:-:-

上海，1937年12月16日

致法租界警务总监，

先生：

谨此告知，《大美晚报》拥有并正在使用一台由中国电气公司（China Electric Co.）制造的五管短波收音机。在购置该设备时，中外当局之间已确立立场，即中国人对无线电台拥有管辖权，且中方已向《大美晚报》保证，其在此方面的行为是正确且合规的。然而，鉴于局势变化，我们希望在此记录现有情况，同时向您保证，我们愿意遵守法租界可能已经存在或将来制定的任何特别规定。

此致
敬礼
签名：Randal Gould
编辑

page_data.en:
Shanghai Chinese Pledge
Allegiance To Government

The three million Chinese
citizens of Shanghai are still in
full support of the Central Gov-
ernment and General Chiang
Kai-shek despite the fact that
the city has been in Japanese
hands for about a month, a mani-
festo purported to represent the
Chinese community here declared.
The manifesto was issued to all
newspapers throughout the coun-
try through the Central News
Agency, Changsha.
Addressed to "fathers, brothers
and sisters," the manifesto
declares that the Chinese citizens
in Shanghai "vow to maintain
the national glory and to uphold
our honor and integrity as citizens
of a free and independent coun-
try."
"We refuse to humiliate our-
selves by cooperating with the
enemy in any way," the manifesto
continued. "We refuse to buy
enemy goods. We refuse to parti-
cipate in any traitorous activities
whatsoever. And we emphatically
repudiate any such spurious or-
ganizations as may be set up by
the enemy. On the contrary, we
pledge continued wholehearted
allegiance to our Central Govern-
ment and full support to our great
leader."
The manifesto went on to urge
the government to redouble efforts
in this "sacred war" for national
existence. "We must now, once
and for all, give up the illusion
of the possibility of a midway
compromise," it is declared.

上海中国人宣誓
效忠政府

尽管本市已被日军占领约一个月，但据称代表本地华人社区的一份宣言宣称，上海三百万中国公民仍全力支持中央政府及蒋介石将军。该宣言通过长沙中央通讯社发往全国各地报纸。
宣言致“父老兄弟姐妹”，宣称上海中国公民“誓保国家荣耀，维护作为自由独立国家公民的荣誉与正直”。
宣言继续写道：“我们拒绝以任何方式与敌人合作来羞辱自己。我们拒绝购买敌货。我们拒绝参与任何叛国活动。我们坚决否认敌人可能设立的任何此类虚假组织。相反，我们宣誓继续全心全意效忠中央政府，并全力支持我们的伟大领袖。”
宣言进而敦促政府在这场关乎民族生存的“神圣战争”中加倍努力。宣言称：“我们现在必须一劳永逸地放弃中途妥协可能性的幻想。”

December 12, 1937.                                  Morning Translation.

Ta Kei Wen Pao (Dec.11) :-

CHINESE RESIDENTS IN SHANGHAI ISSUE MANIFESTO HEARTILY
SUPPORTING THE NATIONAL GOVERNMENT

        The Central News Agency at Changsha publishes
a news item regarding a manifesto issued by some 3,000,000
Chinese residents in Shanghai.    The manifesto reads
as follows :-
        "Although Shanghai fell more than a month
ago, we (the Chinese residents of Shanghai) are still
heartily supporting the National Government and General
Chiang Kai-shek.    We have decided to preserve the
honour of the nation as well as the dignity of the people
of an independent nation.    We are firmly determined
not to co-operate with the enemy nor to buy enemy goods
nor to take part in any traitorous activities.    Puppet
governments formed by the enemy will not be recognized.
In the meantime, we will do our best to continue our
support of the National Government in resisting to the
bitter end.    The Government should continue the war
of resistance for the sake of the existence of the nation
and the people; it should not entertain vain hopes for
a peaceful settlement".

Ta Kung Pao and other local newspapers :-

THE SHOOTING OF A MASON BY AN ITALIAN MARINE

        Zee Sih-zee ( 徐锡之 ), a mason, who was
wounded by a bullet on December 10 fired by an Italian
marine on Robison Road in the Western District, succumbed
to his wounds at 5.40 p.m. yesterday at the Lester
Chinese Hospital.
        Three Italian military officers, accompanied
by foreign policemen of Pootoo Road Police Station,
visited the scene of the incident at 11.30 a.m. yesterday.
The Italian marine responsible for the shooting was also
present.    The marine at first attempted to deny the
shooting, but later acknowledged it after being
interrogated by the Italian officers.    The investigation
lasted about 30 minutes.
        It is learned that an ample compassionate
grant will be issued to the family of the deceased mason.

Social Evening News (Dec.11) :-

REPORTED ARRIVAL OF GENERAL HO YING-CHIN AND GENERAL
HSIUNG SHIH-HWEI UNTRUE

        The report that General Ho Ying-chin,
Minister of War, and General Hsiung Shih-hwei, Chairman
of the Kiangsi Provincial Government, had come to
Shanghai is untrue.

1937年12月12日。                                  晨间译文。

《大基文报》（12月11日）注：此处原文 Ta Kei Wen Pao 疑为 OCR 错误或特定拼写，结合上下文及下文 Ta Kung Pao，通常指《大公报》或其他报刊，但依要求保留原文音译或按常见对应处理，此处根据下文出现 Ta Kung Pao，且 Ta Kei 发音接近 Da Ji 或 Da Gong 的误读，但严格遵循指令“不确定保留原文”，故译为《大基文报》或视情况调整。鉴于下文有 Ta Kung Pao，此处 Ta Kei Wen Pao 极可能是《大公报》(Ta Kung Pao) 的 OCR 误识或另一家报纸。根据历史背景，12月11日左右发布此类消息的多为《大公报》等。但为严谨，若无法确定具体对应中文报名，暂按音译或保留。考虑到“Ta Kei”与“Da Ji”或“Da Gong”差异，且下文明确列出 Ta Kung Pao，此处可能为另一家报纸如《立报》等，但无确切证据。依指令“能确定的用当时通行中文”，若不能确定则保留。此处暂译为《大基文报》(音译) 或参考常见误译。*修正思考*：Ta Kei 可能是 Ta Kung 的误植，或者是指《大晚报》？不，下文有 Social Evening News。让我们看内容。内容是关于宣言。通常《大公报》报道较多。但既然下文单独列出了 Ta Kung Pao，说明 Ta Kei Wen Pao 是另一家。可能是《大美晚报》？不，前面是 Ta Mei Wan Pao。可能是《申报》？Shen Pao。可能是《新闻报》？Sin Pao。Ta Kei 听起来像 "Da Ji"。有可能是《大晚报》(Ta Wan Pao) 的误写？或者是《立报》(Li Bao)？不确定。依指令，不确定保留原文加括号注明音译。但标题翻译需要通顺。此处译为《大基文报》(音译)。

上海中国居民发布宣言
热烈支持国民政府

        长沙中央通讯社发布了一则关于上海约三百万中国居民发布宣言的消息。宣言内容如下：
        “虽然上海在一个多月前沦陷，但我们（上海中国居民）仍然热烈支持国民政府和蒋介石将军。我们决心保持国家荣誉以及独立国家人民的尊严。我们 firmly determined（坚决决定）不与敌人合作，不购买敌货，不参与任何叛国活动。敌人成立的傀儡政府将不予承认。同时，我们将尽全力继续支持国民政府抵抗到底。政府应为国家和人民的生存继续抗战；不应抱有和平解决的虚幻希望”。

《大公报》及其他本地报纸：

意大利水兵枪击一名泥瓦匠

        西区罗宾森路（Robison Road）一名泥瓦匠徐锡之（Zee Sih-zee），于12月10日被一名意大利水兵开枪击伤，昨日下午5时40分在莱斯特的中国医院因伤去世。
        昨天上午11时30分，三名意大利军官在普陀路警署的外国巡捕陪同下前往事发地点。肇事射击的意大利水兵也在场。该水兵起初试图否认射击行为，但在意大利军官讯问后予以承认。调查持续了约30分钟。
        据悉，将向去世泥瓦匠的家属发放一笔丰厚的抚恤金。

《社会晚报》（12月11日）：

何应钦将军与熊式辉将军抵沪报道不实

        关于军政部长何应钦将军和江西省政府主席熊式辉将军抵达上海的报道不实。
